Data 360 Inspector

All-in-one toolkit for Salesforce Data Cloud — explore data without limits, export segment rules, understand transforms instantly, and query any object with full CSV export. Zero setup, read-only, works on any org.

No install · works in any browser

Add the bookmarklet

  1. Show your bookmarks bar: ⌘⇧B on Mac  /  Ctrl⇧B on Windows.
  2. Drag this button to your bookmarks bar:   Data 360 Inspector
  3. Open any Data Cloud / Data 360 page in Salesforce and click the bookmark. A purple circle button appears in the bottom-right corner — click it to open the action menu.
  4. Click the bookmark again at any time to remove the tool.
The launcher sits in the bottom-right corner and never overlaps the Salesforce navigation. Click the purple circle button to expand the menu; click outside or click it again to collapse.

Features by page

🔁 DLO → DMO Mapping canvas

  • API Tooltip — hover any field to see its API name in a tooltip; click to copy to clipboard
  • Pin API names — pins all API names directly on the canvas at once; click Unpin names to clear
  • Export — full DLO→DMO mapping table filterable by DMO · Copy for Sheets or Download CSV

🌐 Data Stream & DLO detail pages

  • Export Fields — all fields with API name, label, data type, status, and key qualifier · Copy for Sheets or Download CSV

🌐 DMO detail pages

  • Export Fields — Fields tab (API name, type, mapped status, key qualifier) and Relationships tab (related objects and join fields) · Copy for Sheets or Download XLS

🏁 Segment Export

  • Reads all segment conditions (Include, Exclude, Rank & Limit) directly from the builder canvas
  • Exports full rule logic with AND/OR joiners, nested segments, and sub-filters
  • Copy to Google Sheets or download as formatted HTML/Excel
  • Share segment documentation with stakeholders without SF access

📊 Data Explorer

  • View ALL columns of any DLO/DMO (breaks SF’s 10-column display limit)
  • Column selector with search, reorder, and save/restore (persists across sessions)
  • Sort any column directly in the table
  • Multi-condition filter (AND/OR) with type-aware controls
  • Real-time record count (shows exact total in the object)
  • Export All — paginated CSV download of the entire object (up to 500K rows) with cancel option
  • Download CSV — downloads loaded or filtered data instantly
  • Edit SQL — inline SQL editor with editable WHERE and LIMIT
  • Hide empty columns toggle to declutter sparse objects

🔎 Query Editor

  • Run & Export — run any SQL query and export full results as CSV (bypasses SF’s 2,000-row UI limit)
  • Paginated export (up to 500K rows) with progress indicator and cancel button
  • Select query with mouse or Cmd+A / Ctrl+A
  • Actionable error messages for common issues

⚙️ Data Transform

  • Auto-reads the transform definition (no manual steps needed)
  • Plain-English summary explaining what the transform does, branch by branch
  • Shows: sources, filters, formulas, joins, outputs with field mappings
  • Column details: which fields are kept, dropped, or renamed
  • Download Summary — styled HTML file, printable as PDF for documentation
  • AI-powered explanation (optional, with API key) for deeper business context
How it works: Drag the bookmarklet to your bookmarks bar. Click it on any supported Data Cloud page. The tool detects the page type and shows the relevant features. Read-only — never modifies your data. Everything stays in your browser.

All modals are draggable (grab the header) and resizable (drag the bottom-right corner).

Launcher menu

Click the blue launcher button (bottom-right corner) to open the menu. Only buttons relevant to the current page are shown.

Privacy & safety

  • Runs entirely in your browser — no external servers, no third-party services.
  • Uses Salesforce’s own APIs (same-origin). No data leaves your browser or your org.
  • Nothing is stored permanently — the tool disappears on page reload. Column selections use localStorage (per-org, 90-day TTL).
  • Read-only: it never creates, modifies, or deletes any Salesforce data.
  • No installation required — no package, no Connected App, no admin approval.
